fomod.Name: Civil War Guard Armor Replacer
fomod.Author: NordwarUA and Gypsymama; assembled by ApocryphaRealm
fomod.Description: Sons of Skyrim, New Legion and the Imperial Tribune armour as one install, with Guards Armor Replacer's Winterhold and Windhelm sets over the Stormcloak hold guards. Spell Perk Item Distributor (7.2+, required) dresses the guards; a single light plugin holds the armour.
